output.summary: A medium-sized tree whose native origin is not stated, found across Africa from Senegal to northern South Africa. It bears large hanging clusters of brown, sausage-shaped fruit and foul-smelling, bell-shaped flowers that open at night and are pollinated by bats. Its fibrous fruit contents are often considered inedible, but are locally eaten cooked; the Maasai also ferment the pulp into strong beer.
